requestBody.description: Raw Stripe **event JSON** (same bytes Stripe POSTs). Header **Stripe-Signature** is required when the provider has a **webhook_secret** (use [Stripe CLI](https://stripe.com/docs/stripe-cli) `stripe listen --forward-to ...` or paste a real signed payload). The example is illustrative only — signature will not verify unless you sign it with your secret.

Raw JSON body (**exact UTF-8 bytes** are HMAC input). Required keys: **event_id**, **amount_original**, **currency_original**. If the provider has **webhook_secret**, set **X-Acs-Signature** to lowercase hex `HMAC_SHA256(utf8(plaintext_secret), body_bytes)` where body_bytes is either the **raw** POST body or **canonical JSON** (sorted keys, `,`/`:` separators — same as `python scripts/xasc_signature_converter.py --canonical`). **Secret** = plaintext you used at provider registration, **not** the `gAAAA…` Fernet value in MongoDB. If the provider was created **without** webhook_secret, omit **X-Acs-Signature** (dev-only).
